events.title: Steam Next Fest – Play the Free Demo Now!
events.summary: Hey, everyone!We have some exciting news! Our game JUST ONE BITE is officially participating in Steam Next Fest starting today!With our Early Access launch on November 2 (PDT) just two weeks away, we’d love for as many of you as possible to come and try out our free Steam demo. We'd really appreciate it if you could leave your feedback and reviews after playing.And if you enjoy it, please consider adding it to your Steam Wishlist and recommending it to others!

events.title: (Demo) General Update
events.summary: Hello everyone!This update adds a new interaction to combat: weapons can now grab players.You can now use your teammates more actively during battle, whether that means pulling them into position, dragging them into the fight, or using the chaos to your advantage.Jump in and try out the new interaction!

events.title: Release Date Update
events.summary: Hello players,We’re sorry to announce that the Early Access release date for Just One Bite has been delayed by 6 days.The release date has been moved from October 27 (PST) to November 2 (PST).This decision was made so we can release the game in a more complete and polished state. events.title: (Demo) Graphics Update
events.summary: Hello everyone,We’ve released a small graphics compatibility update.Fixes- Fixed an issue where some maps could appear too bright or too dark.Known Issue- On certain lower-end graphics cards, shadows in the Island(Upgrade Room) may still appear darker than intended.- We are currently working on this issue and will continue improving the lighting in upcoming updates.Thank you for playing JUST ONE BITE and for sharing your feedback.

events.title: The Just One Bite Demo is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello everyone,The demo for Just One Bite is now live on Steam.Just One Bite is a 1-4 player survival horror game where you collect food, survive dangerous stages, and grow stronger. But be careful, not all food is safe. Some food may suddenly transform into monsters and start hunting you.In the demo, you can play solo or with friends through Steam friend invites and invite codes. events.title: Just One Bite Playtest Is Now Open!
events.summary: (26/08/24) The playtest has ended. Thank you to everyone who participated✨ The Just One Bite Playtest is now open!You can join directly from the Steam store page by clicking the Playtest button. Once accepted, the Playtest version will appear in your Steam Library.This test includes a limited version of the game and is focused on gameplay, balance, and online co-op stability.Thank you for helping us test Just One Bite. We would love to hear your feedback on our Discord or in the Steam Community.
